set.body:
Objective:
Build the one resolved schema, expression, and relational-plan algebra shared by dynamic Frame and Scala 3 named-tuple TypedFrame APIs.

Core contracts:
- Stable ColumnId and ExprId are distinct from display names and qualifiers.
- Expr carries value type and nullability evidence; runtime construction validates existential expressions against the same operator algebra.
- LogicalPlan is immutable, resolved, valid, and free of live resources, captured closures, backend objects, and invalid column references.
- If an ergonomic dynamic builder accumulates errors, it uses a separate PlanDraft or CheckedFrame type before resolution.
- Typed promotion validates schema compatibility once without copying or executing.
- Typed erasure preserves the exact runtime schema and logical plan.

Canonical nodes:
Scan, Values by immutable source reference, Project, Filter, Aggregate, Join, Sort, Limit, Window, Union, and Distinct. Convenience operations lower to these nodes rather than widening the IR.

Acceptance:
- Dynamic schema inspection and typed binding share one runtime schema model.
- Named-tuple column-expression scopes provide typed filter, projection, alias, grouping, and join construction.
- Match types compute projected, aggregated, renamed, and outer-join-nullable schemas.
- General join conditions expose nested left/right scopes; using-key joins may coalesce only explicit equijoin keys and reject other collisions.
- Compile-negative tests reject missing fields, type-invalid operators, unsafe null use, and ambiguous join references.
- JVM and Scala.js produce identical resolved plans for shared fixtures.
set.title: Frame foundation 2: one dynamic/typed schema, expression, and logical-plan algebra
